visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up on a Mahjong table where multiple hands are visible. A person on the left, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and black cord bracelets, is meticulously arranging rows of white Mahjong tiles with colorful engravings. Another hand on the right, adorned with a silver ring, pushes a full rack of tiles into position. The table surface is a dark grey, slightly textured material, and bright lighting illuminates the scene. (2) The shot shifts to a medium view of a young woman with short, reddish-brown hair wearing a white jacket over a blue denim top. She sits at the table, focused on the game, and discards a tile into the center pile. The background features a white wall and a vertical red and blue plaid pattern. A purple and white subtitle overlay appears at the bottom of the frame. (3) A series of quick cuts shows other players revealing their tiles. A woman in a purple striped shirt over a white graphic tee shows four identical tiles, followed by a woman with long blonde hair in a black t-shirt doing the same. The environment is a brightly lit indoor home setting with floral-patterned walls and window blinds visible in the background. (4) The camera captures close-up facial reactions. A young man with dark hair in a grey shirt looks directly toward the camera with a wide-eyed, shocked expression. The first woman is then shown leaning her head on her hand, looking defeated and weary as she stares at the tiles on the table. The editing pace is fast, jumping between the players to capture the unfolding drama.
